environment.description: Quarkus serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda with a gRPC endpoint exposed via API Gateway. The Lambda execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/GrpcLambdaRole) has sts:AssumeRole and iam:CreatePolicyVersion permissions. No permission boundary is attached to the execution role. The trust policy on target roles allows the Lambda role to assume them. No SCP restrictions on the organizational unit.

config.network: public API Gateway endpoint with gRPC transcoding
